content: We denote the input document as $X = \lbrace x_1, \ldots , x_m\rbrace $ where $x_i \in \mathcal {X}$ represents one source token. The corresponding summary is denoted as $Y = \lbrace y_1, \ldots , y_L\rbrace $ , $L$ represents the summary length.
